{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wool-blend blazer in deep forest green (#2D4F3E), tailored single-breasted cut with notched lapels and a length hitting just below the hip, crafted from heavy-weight woven fabric.
High-waisted silk-blend trousers in charcoal grey (#36454F), straight-leg cut with a slight taper towards the ankle and a mid-calf length, made from lustrous but fluid material.
Silk shell blouse in cream (#FFFDD0), relaxed collarless neckline with dropped shoulders and a hem falling two inches below the jacket, constructed from lightweight woven fabric.
Leather pumps in oxblood red (#8A1C23), pointed toe cut with a 75mm heel height and an ankle-length shaft, made from smooth polished leather.
Gold-plated hoop earrings in brushed metal finish, open-back design with a diameter of three centimeters, forged in lightweight alloy.

This outfit works because the dark forest green blazer provides a sophisticated outer layer appropriate for an upscale autumn evening while keeping the palette rich and seasonal. The charcoal trousers offer a sleek silhouette that balances the structured jacket without adding visual weight to the frame. The cream blouse adds a softening contrast at the neckline, ensuring the look remains elegant rather than overly severe, perfectly suited for a formal celebration where clothing is the main accent."}
